dialogue.text: Wata allo, ina nema wata wurin cin abinci da biyu kwararrun.
dialogue.translation: Hello, I'm looking for a restaurant with two seats available.

dialogue.text: Daga wata lokaci zuwa wata, za mu sa ruwa da kome.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe za ku sa wata mace a fice tsaye?
dialogue.translation: When will you have a woman standing at the door?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba zan yi wannan ba. Wata mace ce ce ta tsaye a fice?
dialogue.translation: I won’t do this. Is it a woman who is standing at the door?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I, sai na koyaushe naka mace ce ce ta tsaye a fice.
dialogue.translation: Yes, only your wife is the one always standing at the door.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Babu matsala. Sai ina ne wata wata ke tsaye a fice.
dialogue.translation: There’s no problem. Only someone is standing at the door.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To, sai zan yi wata wata ce. Yaushe ka zo a nan?
dialogue.translation: Well, then I’ll make someone do it. When did you come here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Na zo sau da yaushe. Sai na ga wata mace tsaye a fice.
dialogue.translation: I came long ago. Then I saw a woman standing at the door.

key_phrases.phrase: Yaushe za ku sa wata mace a fice tsaye?
key_phrases.translation: When will you have a woman standing at the door?

key_phrases.translation: Only your wife is the one always standing at the door.

key_phrases.phrase: To, sai zan yi wata wata ce.
key_phrases.translation: Well, then I’ll make someone do it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Bari faɗa wa yaro wata wasanni, sabo ba zan iya yin kwararraki ba.
dialogue.translation: Let me tell the boy a story because I can’t do any work right now.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ina jin wani film na manyan harshe, yana nuna wata irin girma?
dialogue.translation: I heard about a film in a big language. Does it show importance?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ee, cikin wani cikin idanu da ke nuna sabo suka canza duniya.
dialogue.translation: Yes, inside one of the characters shows how they changed the world.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaya wata mace da cikin film ta fi girma?
dialogue.translation: How is a woman in the film more important?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sabo mace ta ke da wasanni da suka sanya idanu na yaro na gabatar da wata sabuwar harshe.
dialogue.translation: Because the woman has skills that made the boy’s character introduce a new language.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: To, wannan wata sabuwar fahimtar film ce da zai dace da yanayin yaro yanzu.
dialogue.translation: Okay, this is a new understanding of film that fits the mindset of boys today.

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of Hausa

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Sabo, zaɗa naka, da harshe da muna yin aiki a cikin wani gida.
dialogue.translation: First, tell me about the language we use to work in this place.

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Idanu muna yin aiki da harshe na Ingilishi, bisa ga zagin da muke da.
dialogue.translation: We work in English, according to the documents we have.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Da faɗa da ke a cikin wata gida tsaye, yaushe na da girma. Me ya kamata mu gani?
dialogue.translation: And the responsibilities in this big place, how important are they? What should we look at?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: A wata gida mai girma, faɗar da ke a ciki na da sabo da shekaru da yaushe.
dialogue.translation: In a big place like this, the responsibilities here have been first for years.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Idanu muna bari cikin gida wata shekara da yaushe. Yaushe muna da wani sabon aiki?
dialogue.translation: We have been here for a year now. Do we always have new work?

key_phrases.translation: We work in English, according to the documents we have.

key_phrases.translation: And the responsibilities in this big place, how important are they?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ya game wani amana sabo fajin shiru?
dialogue.translation: Is he expensive after finishing a meal?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba, game ba ne, amma wani amana bisa shiru ya ba da muna da muna da muna.
dialogue.translation: No, it's not expensive, but some food according to the end makes us full.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wata amanar da ba game da ba, amma ta fada yadda ba a kan sha ba da muna da muna.
dialogue.translation: A food that is not expensive, but it says you can't be full with it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Saboda wata amanar ba ta game ba, sai ka sha da muna da muna.
dialogue.translation: Because a food that is not expensive, you have to eat until you're full.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ina game da wata amanar mai kyau amma ba game ba?
dialogue.translation: How about a nice food that is not expensive?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yaya, wata amanar da ba game ba, amma ta fada mai kyau da muna da muna.
dialogue.translation: Yes, a food that is not expensive, but it says it's nice and fills you up.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Zan tsawo da wannan computer, amma ya zai cika sabon wasanni.
dialogue.translation: I will restart this computer, but it will install new programs.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Me ne sabon wasanni? Kada ka zai baya haka.
dialogue.translation: What are the new programs? Don't install them again like that.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe na so in gani halin computer ne?
dialogue.translation: Should I always check the status of the computer?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba walla a cika wasanni da dama, amma zai zama mai wahala.
dialogue.translation: Not all programs, but it might become complicated.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: A cikin wannan, me zan yi? Ma zan tafi wajen wani mutum da ya iya taimako?
dialogue.translation: In this case, what should I do? Should I go to someone who can help?

key_phrases.translation: I will restart this computer.

key_phrases.phrase: Kada ka zai baya haka.
key_phrases.translation: Don't install them again like that.

key_phrases.phrase: A cikin wannan, me zan yi?
key_phrases.translation: In this case, what should I do?

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of Hausa

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nawa ne farashin wannan gidan yin ciniki?
dialogue.translation: How much is the rent for this apartment?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Farashinsa nawa ne? Ya zai kasance dalasi dubu biyu da rabi a watauku.
dialogue.translation: How much is the price? It will be two thousand five hundred naira per month.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yaushe zan zo gurin amfani da shi?
dialogue.translation: When will I come to use it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba zai yi amfani ba har dai wata biyu da rai.
dialogue.translation: You won't be able to use it until the second week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Amma zan kasance da koyaushe saboda nuna aiki?
dialogue.translation: But will I always be available because of work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kada ka taba damu, ne zai kasance saboda haka ba za ka iya amfani ba.
dialogue.translation: Don't worry so much, because it won't be available for you then.

key_phrases.translation: How much is the rent for this apartment?

key_phrases.translation: It will be two thousand five hundred naira per month.
